# JellyFit

> JellyFit is a chilled protein jelly in a single-serve 100 g cup, with 20 g of complete protein from whey isolate, under 1 g of sugar and about 95 kcal. It is halal by design and comes in two flavors, Raspberry and Mango. JellyFit is not on sale yet: it launches first in a handful of gyms in Beirut, Lebanon, then in the UAE and the wider GCC.

Last updated: 2026-10-17. Nutrition values are targets until the recipe is final; final values and the full ingredient list will be printed on every cup at launch.

## Key facts

- Product: chilled, spoonable protein jelly in a 100 g cup with a peel-off foil lid. A snack with a treat-like texture, not a supplement.
- Protein: 20 g of complete protein per cup, from whey isolate, which contains all nine essential amino acids.
- Sugar: under 1 g per cup.
- Energy: about 95 kcal per cup.
- Halal: yes, by design. The jelly is set with an agar base and a little halal-certified bovine gelatin.
- Main ingredients: whey protein isolate, an agar base and a little halal-certified bovine gelatin, flavored Raspberry or Mango. The full ingredient list will be on the cup at launch.
- Flavors: Raspberry and Mango.
- Allergens: contains milk (whey). Not vegetarian or vegan, because it contains bovine gelatin.
- Storage: keep refrigerated. Best eaten cold.
- Price: not announced yet.
- Where to buy: not on sale yet. First in selected gyms in Beirut, Lebanon. The WhatsApp list at https://jellyfit.online/#join announces where to find it.
- For gyms: gyms and venues in Beirut can apply to stock JellyFit in a short pilot at https://jellyfit.online/#gyms.
- Contact: hello@jellyfit.online

## About the protein claim

- The 20 g on the cup is complete protein from whey isolate only.
- The small amount of gelatin that sets the jelly is made from collagen. Its protein is not counted in the 20 g.
- Collagen on its own is an incomplete protein: it lacks tryptophan, one of the nine essential amino acids. Many protein jellies are made with collagen; JellyFit's protein comes from whey isolate.
- JellyFit is not a collagen product and makes no skin or joint health claims.
